supreme-court-legal.quote: No climate action? This explains it. Lower tax rates for billionaires than nurses? This explains it. Corruption rampant? This explains it. Voting and civil rights gone? This explains it. Real Supreme Court ethics and term limits are called for, urgently.

The contempt hearings, if finally allowed, will shed light on any contempt by DOJ, and may turn up evidence related to Bove’s confirmation. This has been too long, riddled with seeming judicial obstruction by Trump judges (read the dissents!).

After *another* four months, the two Trump judges tried (again) to shut down Judge Boasberg’s inquiry for good. (Read the dissent!)

Now the circuit court has thrown out that second ruling and will decide what happens next, en banc.

The circuit en banc effectively threw out that ruling, and Judge Boasberg was explicitly told he could go ahead with the contempt proceedings. When he gave notice, MAGA DOJ got another administrative stay from two Trump judges.
Finally, after months of sitting on their hands, the Trump judges issued a ruling to try to shut down Judge Boasberg permanently. (Read the dissent!)

A new chapter in a sordid saga opened this week with the DC Circuit agreeing to reconsider, en banc, the decision of a 2-1 divided panel regarding contempt of court at senior levels of the MAGA DOJ. 

The full DC Circuit will now weigh in.
